name: scene_style_r2
title: Card scenes, round 2: style test
intro: Twelve scenes to judge the look, not the subjects: four scenes in each of three illustrative styles. Each tile is the bare scene over two real cards, a program or event and a building, composed at 300 dpi with the full bleed showing: the program window is the whole scene, the building window its centre. The cards are placeholders, not assignments; scenes are a pool, and Adversary has no card tag, so its cards are the nearest fit. For true size, print art-originals/scenes/r2/cards.pdf at 100%. Use the notes for what to change.
